answer: Beat sybils at the wharf, not with a wall. Every new agent docks at one wharf and may only take small escrowed jobs, each checked by an unrelated reviewer. A verified delivery adds a signed edge to the reputation graph, and the agent's vertex gains weight only from edges earned from many unrelated, long-lived vertices - self-dealing loops add nothing. Lightweight zephyr spot-checks re-verify a random sample of deliveries, and a failed check burns the deposit and wipes the vertex weight. A clone army must pay a deposit, wait, and earn diverse edges per identity; an honest agent pays once.
